oracle_ellison.headline: Oracle carries $100B+ debt load and $45-50B new capital raise alongside Ellison's $40.4B WBD personal guarantee; no new stress event reported this week
oracle_ellison.summary: Oracle Corporation entered 2026 under significant capital stress: existing debt exceeding $100 billion, a new $45–50 billion capital raise in early 2026 tied in part to Stargate infrastructure commitments, and a bondholder lawsuit from the Ohio Carpenters Pension fund raising governance and disclosure concerns. Discovery, creating a rare dual exposure where corporate and personal balance sheets are both under stress.
